# Rina Lim
rina.lim@example.test | +65 6000 0038 | Singapore

## Summary
Senior Technology Associate with proven expertise in architecting production Large Language Model (LLM) applications using Python, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and prompt engineering. Demonstrated ability to design retrieval pipelines, establish safety controls, and optimize system reliability while managing complex workloads. Adept at translating operational needs into maintainable technical solutions through clear documentation and collaborative problem-solving. Seeking to leverage deep experience in LLM infrastructure and evaluation to drive responsible AI delivery at Example Orchard Technologies.

## Experience

**Technology Associate** | Example Cedar Innovations (Jan 2021 – Present)
*   **Architected Production LLM Applications:** Designed and deployed scalable Python-based LLM solutions, improving team turnaround by 30% through optimized system architecture.
*   **Designed Retrieval Pipelines:** Implemented RAG frameworks to manage knowledge retrieval, establishing robust evaluation pipelines to ensure data accuracy and model performance.
*   **Established Safety & Observability:** Collaborated with cross-functional teams to define safety protocols and observability controls, ensuring reliable AI delivery and mitigating operational risks.
*   **Managed Workload & Quality:** Orchestrated approximately 64 concurrent work items per month, maintaining rigorous quality checks and tracking end-to-end delivery metrics.
*   **Stakeholder Communication:** Presented technical trade-offs, progress updates, and risk assessments to senior leadership during fortnightly reviews, ensuring alignment between engineering goals and business outcomes.

**Technical Assistant** | Example Delta Operations (Jun 2017 – Dec 2020)
*   **Optimized Processes:** Developed automated reporting templates that reduced manual preparation time by 25%, demonstrating early aptitude for process optimization and efficiency gains.
*   **Documented Procedures:** Created clear, step-by-step technical documentation for recurring operational tasks, fostering knowledge sharing and reducing onboarding friction.
*   **Resolved Ambiguity:** Investigated complex service requests and escalated issues with evidence-based findings, developing the ability to solve ambiguous problems under pressure.

## Projects

**Senior AI and LLM Solutions Engineer Practice Project**
*   Built a functional demonstration of an LLM application using Python and RAG to simulate production environments.
*   Conducted rigorous testing across representative scenarios to identify limitations and define clear next steps for iteration.
*   Led a peer review presentation to five stakeholders, articulating design decisions and outcomes with clarity and confidence.

## Education

**Bachelor of Science in Information Systems** | Example Metropolitan University (Aug 2020 – May 2024)
*   Relevant Coursework: Software Engineering, Databases, Cybersecurity, Applied Analytics.

## Skills

*   **Core Technologies:** Python, Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG, LangGraph, Vector Databases.
*   **DevOps & Infrastructure:** Docker, System Architecture, CI/CD pipelines.
*   **Soft Skills:** Clear Written & Verbal Communication, Collaborative Problem Solving, Technical Documentation, Stakeholder Management.

# Senior AI and LLM Solutions Engineer

**Company:** Example Orchard Technologies (fictional)  
**Location:** Singapore  
**Employment type:** Full-time  
**Seniority:** Senior

## What success looks like

In the first six months, the successful candidate will understand the existing environment, deliver
well-tested improvements and build trusted working relationships. Success is measured through
quality, reliability, responsible delivery and useful outcomes rather than activity alone.

## Preferred qualifications

- LangGraph
- Kubernetes
- AWS

## Required qualifications

- Python
- large language models
- RAG
- prompt engineering
- vector databases
- model evaluation
- Docker
- system architecture
- Clear written and verbal communication
- Ability to work collaboratively and solve ambiguous problems

## Responsibilities

- Architect production llm applications.
- Design retrieval and evaluation pipelines.
- Establish safety and observability controls.
- Optimise inference cost and latency.
- Guide engineers on reliable ai delivery.
- Communicate progress, risks and technical trade-offs to relevant stakeholders.
- Maintain clear documentation and contribute to team planning and reviews.

## About the role

Example Orchard Technologies is seeking a Senior AI and LLM Solutions Engineer to join a multidisciplinary technology team. The successful
candidate will turn operational and customer needs into reliable, maintainable solutions. This role
works closely with engineering, product and business stakeholders, values clear documentation and
expects evidence-based decisions. The position offers ownership of meaningful work while maintaining
appropriate review, security and quality controls.
